stations.title: Theo
stations.say: I scroll all day to find things.
stations.note: The site is one long file.

stations.title: shop.js
stations.text: Candles, stock rules and the page, in one.

captions: Prices live in one file now. Next, Theo's site file has grown too long to read.
Ines wants to change when a candle counts as low, and cannot find the number.
You move the candles, the stock rules and the page into files of their own.
The low stock number comes from the settings now, and stock.js reads it.
Each part of the site has a file named after it, and shop.js only runs them.
